biggest_catch: Applying never guarantees a response — founders pick who to engage with, and startup roles are competitive.
catches: No payment handled by the board — offers and pay are negotiated with each startup.
Most listings show salary and equity upfront, but not all; pay is per offer.
YC-style startup roles are competitive; a profile does not guarantee founder contact.
Many roles are salaried employment with interviews, not instant gigs.

c1.evidence: Wellfound's official job-seeker page states: 'Wellfound is a job marketplace built specifically for startup and tech jobs. As of 2026, 27,000+ startups hire on Wellfound, over 10 million candidates use it, and it has powered 100,000+ hires. Job seekers use it free: one profile, one-click applications, salary and equity shown on listings, and direct contact with founders.' — a live, provider-owned deal channel.

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Most job listings on Wellfound include the salary range and equity details upfront' — pay varies per offer; framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official FAQ: 'Create one profile and apply with a single click. No cover letters: your profile is your application, and responses come directly from founders and hiring managers.'

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Is Wellfound free for job seekers? Yes. Creating a profile and applying to jobs on Wellfound is always free for candidates.'

eligibility: Anyone who can build a candidate profile and meet listed startup role requirements.
notes: Scenario: startup job marketplace. Wellfound (formerly AngelList Talent) connects candidates with 27,000+ startups: one profile, one-click applications, salary and equity shown upfront on most listings, direct contact with founders. Applying is always free for candidates. Pay is per offer and negotiated — variable, never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: most listings show salary/equity ranges upfront; compensation is per offer and negotiated. time: build profile + browse + one-click apply to matching roles, est. 30-90 min active.
payout_quote: Job seekers use it free: one profile, one-click applications, salary and equity shown on listings, and direct contact with founders.
payout_value_note: Most listings show salary and equity ranges upfront; compensation is set per startup and negotiated per offer — variable.

steps: Create one candidate profile on Wellfound (always free for job seekers).
Browse startup roles by category, location, and remote status; most listings show salary and equity upfront.
Apply with one click — your profile is your application, no cover letters.
Respond directly to founders and hiring managers who engage with your application.
timing: Listings post continuously; hiring timelines follow each startup.
